name: IBY_BEPINFO_
description: IBY_BEPKEYS stores information about the payment systems.

columns.name: BEPID
columns.description: System-generated primary key.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of the payment system.

columns.name: BASEURL
columns.description: URL to the payment system

columns.name: SUFFIX
columns.description: Three-letter payment system suffix.  This is unique per payment system

columns.name: BEPUSERNAME
columns.description: User name for authenticating from Oracle Payments to payment system.

columns.name: BEPPASSWORD
columns.description: Password for payment system user name.

columns.name: PMTSCHEMEID
columns.description: payment scheme identifier

columns.name: SUPPORTEDOP
columns.description: Bitmap to denote operations supported by bank end payment system

columns.name: PSUSERNAME
columns.description: User name for authenticating from payment system to Oracle Payments.

columns.name: PSPASSWORD
columns.description: Password for PSUSERNAME

columns.name: ADMINURL
columns.description: URL to the native Back End Payment System admin pages

columns.name: LOGINURL
columns.description: Log in URL to the payment system.

columns.name: LOGOUTURL
columns.description: Log out URL to the payment system.

columns.name: LEADTIME
columns.description: Lead time that is needed to schedule the payment

columns.name: HOLIDAYFILE
columns.description: Denotes support for holiday file

columns.name: SRVRIDIMMED
columns.description: Y or N flag indicating that Server ID is immediately sent

columns.name: FILESUPPORT
columns.description: Y or N flag

columns.name: ACTIVESTATUS
columns.description: Indicates whether payment system is active or not

columns.name: INSTRTYPE
columns.description: Instrument type

columns.name: SECURITYSCHEME
columns.description: Denotes whether HTML Page or Wallet for invoice or pay operation

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SECURITY_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Security group, used in hosted environment.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to party at HZ_PARTIES_ALL.PARTY_ID.

columns.name: BEP_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment system is a processor or gateway model payment system.  Values for this column include: PROCESSOR and GATEWAY

columns.name: MAX_BATCH_SIZE
columns.description: No longer used

columns.name: OUTBOUND_INVALID_CHARS
columns.description: Invalid characters to be replaced by the corresponding replacement characters. Generally should have positional correspondence with the replacement ones. For Citi-Payables only.

columns.name: OUTBOUND_REPLACE_CHARS
columns.description: Replacement characters corresponding to the invalid characters. Generally should have positional correspondence with the invalid ones. For Citi-Payables only.

columns.name: BANK_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to party at HZ_PARTIES_ALL.PARTY_ID.

columns.name: NLS_LANGUAGE
columns.description: NLS language character set for the payment system network communication.

columns.name: INACTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Inactive date

columns.name: SEEDED_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N flag indicating that the data is seeded record
